model_numbers: XT2621-6 (global G87); BR sold as 'moto g max'
notes: Global G87 announced Apr 29 2026, released May 15 2026. 200 MP f/1.8 OIS + 8 MP UW 118° (GSMArena confirmed), 5,000-nit 1.5K AMOLED, IP66/68/69, MIL-STD-810H. Brazil launch as 'Moto G Max' circa Jun 11 2026 (BRL 2,519.10, official store). India price (~Rs 21,999) officially revealed but NOT on sale via Indian channels as of mid-June 2026 - flip india to true once Flipkart sales open; note Rs 21,999 is below the app's Rs 30K+ target band. Stock video caps at 1440p30 / 1080p60 (no 4K). Gyro + accelerometer present per GSMArena.
caveats: UW FOV (118°) clears the >=118° bar on paper, but Motorola historically hides ultrawide camera IDs from third-party Camera2 apps despite native-app access (GameChanger finding; only some newer Edge models confirmed open) - no per-model evidence the G87 exposes UW via CONTROL_ZOOM_RATIO <1.0 or a separate public ID; runtime probe required. Dimensity 6400 is a rebadged Dimensity 6300/6100+ (Helio G99 lineage, 6 nm) - budget-MediaTek encoder tier: sibling silicon (Galaxy A15, MT6835/Dimensity 6100+ class) has documented HEVC Surface-input CBR timestamp instability (RootEncoder #1412, unresolved), and WebRTC forces FRAMERATE_ADJUSTMENT on all MTK encoders (rate control assumes configured fps, mis-tracks CBR under frame-rate variance); compat-check MUST verify c2.mtk.hevc.encoder exists and isBitrateModeSupported(CBR)==true, plus track-header 1920x1080 + mean-fps gates already in FinalizeWorker. NOT confirmed on the ARCore certified-devices list as of 2026-06-12 (device too new; Moto G85 also absent) - so neither sustained >=100 Hz IMU nor SENSOR_INFO_TIMESTAMP_SOURCE=REALTIME is verifiable; budget-MTK tier frequently reports UNKNOWN timestamp source. Thermal: 1080p30 HEVC is a light load for this 6 nm low-power SoC in a large 5,200 mAh IP69 chassis - low throttling risk but no sustained-capture evidence. Full GMS + Play Integrity (standard Motorola). Brazil-only for now; India availability pending. Minor source disagreement: charging listed 30W (GSMArena, G87) vs 33W (Gizmochina, G Max).
